shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch; cat package.json; sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; cat .lore/test-commands.yml"
/bin/zsh -lc 'ls node_modules/ajv; npm ls ajv --depth=0; git log -3 --oneline'

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n '\"node_modules/ajv\"|\"ajv\":|npm ci|npm install|omit' package-lock.json .github/workflows; cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | head -35; git status --short; rg -n 'ajv' .npmrc jest.config* tsconfig*"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '4878,4905p' package-lock.json; git show HEAD:package-lock.json | sed -n '4878,4905p'; ls -l node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv*; cat .github/workflows/ci.yml | sed -n '30,60p'; rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]|validated by' src/orchestration/tools/*.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main; git log --oneline --left-right HEAD...origin/main | head -30; git merge-tree $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) HEAD origin/main | rg -n -C 3 '"'ajv|package-lock|package.json'"

/bin/zsh -lc "git ls-files package-lock.json; git show --stat 84eab6e; git show --stat 08b458e; cat .gitignore | rg -n 'lock|node_modules'; node -p \"require.resolve('ajv/dist/ajv.js')\"; git status --branch --short"
/bin/zsh -lc "git show HEAD:package.json | rg ajv; git show HEAD:package-lock.json | rg -n '\"node_modules/ajv\"|\"ajv\": \"\\"'^8'"'; git log -p -- package.json | rg -n -C 3 ajv"
/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat; git diff -- package-lock.json | head -100; node --input-type=module -e \"import {Ajv} from 'ajv/dist/ajv.js'; console.log(typeof Ajv)\"; git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='.lore/dod.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Confirm CI resolves Ajv 8 for typechecking and test execution.', '- [x] Repair the lockfile so a clean npm install succeeds.\\n- [ ] Confirm CI resolves Ajv 8 for typechecking and test execution.')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx prettier --write package-lock.json .lore/dod.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add package-lock.json .lore/dod.md && git commit -m 'Repair clean npm installation lockfile' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --branch --short"
